name: Extract website Markdown and source chunks with Apify and HTTP Request

parameters.content:
# Website pages to source packets

For researchers and automation builders preparing public website passages for account briefs or a retrieval workflow.

### How it works

Run manually to collect 1–10 explicit URLs through Mako's Web Content Crawler on Apify. HTTP Request nodes start one bounded run, poll its status, and fetch the report and dataset. Checks reject missing, failed, empty or truncated output. Each accepted chunk retains its source URL, heading path and crawl time. Oversized chunks remain flagged and intact.

### Setup

1. Import the JSON.
2. Create Header Auth with name `Authorization` and value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`. Select it in all five HTTP Request nodes.
3. Edit `startUrls` in **Configure crawl**. The page budget follows the URL count; link following stays off.
4. Execute manually. Inspect the coverage report, then **Source packets**.

### Requirements and costs

Use n8n and an Apify account with available credit. The template is free; the author's Apify Actor charges a startup event. At 512 MB, the Free-tier rate checked on 2 October 2026 was $0.05 per run, including normal run platform usage. This workflow sets a $0.10 Actor ceiling and 180-second timeout. Post-run data access and n8n hosting can cost extra.

### Customization

Replace the URLs and connect your own retrieval or AI step after reviewing the output. This starter reads server-rendered public HTML and creates source passages; it does not render JavaScript, create embeddings or populate a CRM.

[Inspect the two-page, 33-chunk example](https://makorev.com/apis/website-research) · [Detailed setup](https://github.com/valdeircs/scraper-fleet/blob/main/examples/website-research/docs/n8n-setup.md)

## 1. Configure and start
Choose explicit URLs and attach your Apify credential. Start one bounded run.

## 2. Wait for the same run
Poll without creating another run. Abort on polling errors or deadline.

## 3. Check coverage and retrieve
Require success, complete seed coverage and untruncated output before accepting page data.

## 4. Build source packets
Preserve citations, timestamps and content hashes. Review oversized flags before connecting another system.
